# Anna-Lena Guske

> Head of Climate Policy & Socio-ecological Transformation, based in Berlin (Germany).
> Expert in EU and federal funding who bridges politics, science, public administration
> and civil society to shape effective, socially just climate transformation.

## Who

- Name: Anna-Lena Guske
- Role: Leitung Klimapolitik & sozial-ökologische Transformation (Head of Climate Policy & Socio-ecological Transformation)
- Organisation: Diakonie Deutschland (https://www.diakonie.de)
- Location: Berlin, Germany
- Languages: German (native), English, Spanish

## Expertise

- Climate policy (Klimapolitik)
- Socio-ecological transformation (sozial-ökologische Transformation)
- Climate justice (Klimagerechtigkeit)
- Just transition
- EU funding programmes (EU-Fördermittel)
- Federal funding, Germany (Bundesförderung)
- Policy advice (Politikberatung)
- Sustainability research (Nachhaltigkeitsforschung)
- Environmental policy (Umweltpolitik)
- Civil society engagement (zivilgesellschaftliches Engagement)

## Education

- Freie Universität Berlin (https://www.fu-berlin.de)
- Philipps-Universität Marburg (https://www.uni-marburg.de)

## Notable work

- Author / co-author of 21 academic and policy publications on climate policy,
  socio-ecological transformation, environmental policy and sustainable economy.
- Peer-reviewed journals include Sustainability, GAIA and Sozialer Fortschritt.
- Numerous policy reports for the German Environment Agency (Umweltbundesamt / UBA),
  OECD, the European Commission and Bertelsmann Stiftung.
- Full, citable publication list with links: https://annalenaguske.de/#publikationen
